responsibility: Emits x86 ELF GNU property notes at file end for Linux/GNU targets. This file owns construction of the .note.gnu.property payload describing CET control-flow protection features and the required x86 ISA level, combining target state such as flag_cf_protection and ix86_needed into GNU_PROPERTY_X86_FEATURE_1_AND and GNU_PROPERTY_X86_ISA_1_NEEDED notes alongside the executable-stack marker emitted for the translation unit.
